tables.name: articles
tables.label: Library
tables.description: Wikipedia articles cached for offline reading — images are optional per save. Includes seeds you picked directly and articles reached by crawling links.

tables.name: links
tables.label: Links
tables.description: Outgoing links discovered on a cached article, and whether the target article has been fetched yet.

tables.name: crawl_queue
tables.label: Crawl queue
tables.description: Articles discovered by a crawl and their fetch status — pending, fetched or failed. Lets a crawl pause and resume.

tables.name: crawls
tables.label: Crawls
tables.description: One row per crawl run — its seed article, wiki, depth cap and status. Multiple crawls can overlap the same cached pages; see crawl_members.

tables.name: crawl_members
tables.label: Crawl membership
tables.description: Which pages belong to which crawl, and at what depth — the shared-cache join: one articles row can be a member of several crawls without being re-downloaded.

tables.name: searchResults
tables.label: Search results
tables.description: Live Wikipedia search results for the current query — transient, cleared and replaced on every search. Tap a row to save it into Library.

tables.name: searchStatus
tables.label: Search status
tables.description: Single-row status flag (idle/loading/empty/results) driving the search screen's loading and empty states.

tables.name: readerStatus
tables.label: Reader status
tables.description: Single-row scratch state for the reader screen — which article is open, and whether its cache is stale enough to prompt a check for updates.

tables.name: liveArticle
tables.label: Reading now
tables.description: Reader v2 (R5, read-first): single-row scratch holding whatever is CURRENTLY open in the reader — a live (unsaved) fetch, or a copy of a saved Library row. Nothing here is Library content; only an explicit "Save offline" tap ever inserts into articles.

tables.name: sections
tables.label: Sections
tables.description: Reader v2 (R3): the heading outline of whatever liveArticle currently holds — recomputed every time liveArticle changes. Drives the reader's sections index chip row.

tables.name: linkChoiceStatus
tables.label: Link choice
tables.description: Reader v2 (R2): single-row scratch holding an in-article wikilink's target while the reader shows the "not cached yet" choice screen (Save & read / Queue for caching / Open on Wikipedia).

tables.name: recentReads
tables.label: Recently read
tables.description: v3a (W1): a short trail of articles opened in the reader, live or cached, most recent first — feeds the home screen's "Recently read" list. Not the Library; nothing here implies the article is saved offline.

tables.name: queueStatus
tables.label: Queue status
tables.description: polish1-0818: single-row scratch state driving the Crawl queue screen's Resume control. "interrupted" only ever appears once per boot — pending rows found already queued before this session ever touched them, since a crawl run is an in-memory fiber that cannot survive a page reload.

tables.name: articleImages
tables.label: Article images
tables.description: W2 (v3b design of record): one lead-image payload per saved article, local base64 bytes only, never fetched over the network at render time — an article's extractText references its row as `![alt](local:<id>)`. Never re-encoded or re-fetched; deleted together with its owning article.

tables.name: saveOptions
tables.label: Save options
tables.description: W7: single-row scratch holding the CURRENT per-save choices (include images, cache depth) — read by the save action at the moment "Save offline"/"+ Save" is tapped, not stored per-article afterward.
